summary:
Verification of P4 SMTP-async fix from iteration_5. Confirmed: (1) all 4 SMTP call-sites wrapped in asyncio.to_thread (server.py:790, 1313, 1388, 1950), (2) both SMTP_SSL calls use timeout=10 (server.py:335, 427), (3) event loop is no longer blocked (other endpoints stay responsive during SMTP hang - stripe webhook + captcha responded in ms while budget was still hanging). REGRESSION 49/49 previous tests still pass (29 backend + 20 security). /api/sectors still returns 3 items (inmobiliarias, clinicas-dentales, salones-belleza). No coroutine bugs anywhere.

HOWEVER, the <15s wall-clock target is NOT fully met: /api/contact/budget returns in ~20.2s when SMTP is unreachable (down from 60-90s, but above the 15s spec). Backend log shows single 'timed out' event per request, so smtplib.SMTP_SSL(timeout=10) fires once but the total socket lifecycle (getaddrinfo + TCP connect + SSL handshake) accumulates ~20s. Same for POST /api/admin/access-links with send_email=true (~20.2s). Root cause: smtplib.SMTP_SSL applies timeout per socket op and the internal connect() implicitly wraps SSL on top of a fresh TCP connect; connect timeout is deterministically 10s but the SSL wrap adds another ~10s before smtplib re-raises TimeoutError.

minor.issue: Wall-clock time when SMTP host unreachable is ~20s, not <15s as specified. Fix: either lower SMTP_SSL timeout to 5s, or wrap the whole send in asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=12) so worst-case is bounded regardless of smtplib internal retries. Current behavior is a 3-4x improvement over pre-fix (60-90s -> 20s) and event loop is no longer blocked, so this is a P4-P5, not a blocker.

pre_existing_unrelated_failures.issue: level='weirdlevel' passes through without normalization to 'full'|'demo' (test_create_unknown_level_normalizes). Pre-existing, unrelated to SMTP change.
customer_email 'TEST_skip@example.com' stored lowercased as 'test_skip@example.com' (test_validate_token_works). Pre-existing, unrelated to SMTP change.

verified.asyncio_to_thread_wrapping: grep confirms 4 asyncio.to_thread call-sites for send_purchase_email + send_budget_request_email (server.py lines 790, 1313, 1388, 1950). No naked sync SMTP calls left in async endpoints.
verified.smtp_timeout_10s: smtplib.SMTP_SSL(..., timeout=10) confirmed at server.py:335 and :427. Backend log shows 'timed out' error, confirming the timeout fires.
verified.event_loop_not_blocked: During 20s SMTP hang, /api/webhook/stripe and /api/captcha responded normally in same test run - proves single-worker uvicorn is no longer stalled by SMTP.
verified.no_coroutine_bugs: POST /api/admin/access-links with send_email=true returns 200 with body containing 'email_sent' key; POST /api/webhook/stripe returns 400 (bad sig) - no 500 / TypeError('coroutine was never awaited') anywhere.
verified.regression_20_20_security: tests/test_security_fixes.py -> 20 PASS + 1 pytest.skip (budget captcha replay skipped by design). Total 49/49 requested regression PASS.
verified.sectors_3_items: GET /api/sectors returns {inmobiliarias, clinicas-dentales, salones-belleza}, deployment_id hidden in list, exposed (empty) in detail.

action_items: Optional: Bound the SMTP send wall-clock explicitly to <15s. Either (a) reduce smtplib.SMTP_SSL timeout from 10 to 5 (fastest fix), or (b) wrap the asyncio.to_thread call in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=12). Current ~20s is acceptable UX (single response, event loop free) but doesn't meet the literal <15s spec.
Unrelated: /api/admin/access-links does not normalize 'level' to allowed values ('weirdlevel' accepted) and lowercases customer_email (pre-existing, out of scope for this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: SMTP async fix is architecturally correct: asyncio.to_thread properly offloads blocking I/O; timeout on SMTP_SSL prevents indefinite hang. Only the total wall-clock (~20s) exceeds the stated <15s target.
Consider adding asyncio.wait_for around the to_thread call as belt-and-braces so a future smtplib change can't reintroduce runaway waits.

success_rate.backend: 100% on regression (49/49). SMTP timing spec: partial (event-loop unblocked + timeout fires + no coroutine bugs = PASS; wall-clock <15s target = FAIL at 20s).

seed_data_creation: One captcha_used entry per budget test (expected, TTL cleans up). One TEST_ access link created via admin endpoint. No permanent seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To rerun: `pytest /app/tests/ --tb=short` (uses /app rootdir) AND `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/` separately (both dirs have __init__.py so pytest can't collect them together from /app). SMTP host psicolfis.net:465 is unreachable from preview - budget test measures the timeout path. If main agent lowers smtplib timeout to 5s, re-run test_smtp_async_timing.py::TestBudgetSMTPTiming to confirm <15s.
rca of the issue: SMTP timeout works but per-socket-operation (connect + SSL wrap each ~10s) accumulates ~20s wall-clock. Backend log 'Error sending budget request email: timed out' confirms only one exception is raised, so smtplib is not retrying - the extra time comes from the SSL layer atop the timed-out TCP socket. Mitigation is to either shorten the smtplib timeout to 5s or add asyncio.wait_for around the to_thread call.
